newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Dec bad cheque ratio rises to 0.63 percent.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Dec bad cheque ratio rises to 0.63 percent.

text.p: Taiwan's bad-cheque ratio rose to 0.63 percent in December, up from 0.60 percent in November, the central bank said in a statement on Wednesday.
Bad cheques made up 0.42 percent of the total value of all cheques written, unchanged from November.
The total number of bad cheques was down 8.43 percent from November while the value of bad cheques decreased 1.14 percent.
The central bank gave no specific totals for the value and number of bad cheques.
